title: AI agents, explained in 40 seconds

hook.headline: Why everyone's talking about *AI agents*
hook.voice: Everyone is suddenly talking about AI agents. Here's what they are, in forty seconds.

stories.label: What it is
stories.headline: AI that *does* tasks, not just chats
stories.voice: A chatbot answers questions. An AI agent takes actions, like clicking, typing and using apps, to finish a task for you.

stories.label: Why now
stories.headline: Every big lab is *shipping* one
stories.voice: Next. Models got good enough at planning and using tools, so the big AI labs are now building agents into their products.

stories.label: For you
stories.headline: Your next assistant *books* it for you
stories.voice: And finally. Soon you could ask an agent to compare prices or fill a form, and just check its work at the end.

outro_question: Would you trust an *agent* with that?
outro_voice: Would you trust an AI agent to do your tasks? Tell me in the comments.
